title: Gloria (Riquet, Missa Susanne un jour)
desc: Pere Riquet, Missa Susanne un jour, Gloria, c. 1550-1600. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0032_2); edited by Andrea Puentes, Vincent Besson. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
